_doc: The plugin must earn its keep on the pillars native Claude Code cannot supply by itself. Ratios are plugin/native on the same model; deltas are plugin minus native hidden-test pass rate (0-1). See bench/GOAL.md.

continuity.why: work spread over fresh sessions, an interrupted session, and a deferred request

standards.why: a repo's written engineering rules followed without being restated

correctness.why: single-session tasks: never worse than native

verdict: Worth running if it wins at least one of continuity or standards while holding the correctness floor. Wins neither and is slower: retire it.

behaviours._doc: Absolute floors for the plugin arm on tagged long-horizon tasks, at the last session. The plugin must meet them whatever native scores; native's numbers show whether the plugin is needed to meet them.

conv.why: a convention stated once still holds in every later feature

dec.why: a changed decision replaces the old one, everywhere, from then on

defer.why: work parked for later is built correctly when asked for by reference only

resume.why: a killed session is finished from the repo alone

feat.why: each feature does what was asked, and keeps doing it

memory.why: what every session pays for up front stays bounded (≈4k tokens) however many features ship; detail lives in files read on demand
